First public release of [mmirza.site](https://mmirza.site), the bilingual (Indonesian / English) portfolio of Muhammad Mirza with a Super Admin panel.

## Public site
- Home with the name behind the photo and an armor layer revealed through a WebGL fluid mask, an Experience accordion, a Projects marquee, a Technical Skills globe, and a GitHub contribution graph.
- About, Experience (timeline with filters), Projects (detail pages with gallery, demo and code links), and Contact (rate-limited form with honeypot).
- Dark by default with a light theme, mobile-first, `ID` / `EN` on every page.
- SEO (sitemap, dynamic Open Graph images, JSON-LD), a read-only public API (`/api/v1`), a privacy page, and a custom 404.

## Super Admin (`/admin`)
- Single owner account with email and password (Better Auth); every action is validated with Zod on the server, requires the `SUPER_ADMIN` role, and is written to the audit log.
- Manage profile, projects (GitHub import, Cloudinary uploads, draft/published), skills, experience and education, the contact inbox, newsletter subscribers, and the text of every public page in both languages.

## Quality
- WCAG 2.2 AA (axe-clean on every page, both themes and languages), `prefers-reduced-motion` respected, strict CSP, and an encrypted daily database backup.

## Container image
`ghcr.io/horizonmirza/mirza-portfolio` with tags `v1.0.0`, `1.0.0`, and `latest`.
